Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunset Plaza LLC operates as a shopping center and strip mall, providing a diverse range of retail spaces for various tenants including clothing stores, restaurants, and service providers. Our facility features ample parking, landscaped common areas, and well-maintained building systems to support tenant operations. We prioritize a safe and welcoming environment for our customers while ensuring efficient management of the property. In addition, we continuously evaluate our insurance needs to address potential risks, including maintenance and equipment breakdown, cyber liability, and employment practices liability, to safeguard our tenants and operations.

Underwriting Guidelines:
Preferred Optional Coverages
To enhance protection and address common exposures, the
following optional coverages are recommended for shopping centers and strip malls:
• Maintenance and Equipment Breakdown Coverage: Covers the cost to repair or re-
place essential building systems such as HVAC, electrical panels, and refrigeration units, which
are critical for tenant operations.
• Employment Practices Liability Insurance (EPLI): Protects against claims related
to wrongful termination, discrimination, or harassment by property management or tenant
employees.
• Cyber Liability: Addresses risks associated with data breaches or cyberattacks, particularly
relevant if the property management collects tenant or customer data electronically.
• Flood Insurance: Especially important for properties located in flood-prone areas or des-
ignated flood zones, as standard BOPs exclude flood coverage.
